feat(labelexpert): migrate camellia scene pages

Summary:
- add a concrete mscene leaf view so dynamic menu routing resolves the
  labelexpert module pages instead of the placeholder view
- remove hard-coded app and route assumptions from labelexpert device,
  scene, and mscene pages so list/detail/manage flows follow the active
  module context
- widen shared tree-view typing and related universal API types to match
  the data shapes used by the migrated mscene and scene pages

Rationale:
- the DAM-29 migration target required device, scene, and mscene to be
  reachable under the new backend with the shared camellia list and form
  flow
- mscene was still pinned to metaprint and a fixed route path, which broke
  module-level reuse and permission-driven navigation
- the migrated pages surfaced existing type gaps around string node ids and
  vendor typings that needed to be aligned for local validation

Tests:
- cd woodii && (npm run typecheck || true) | rg "src/views/app/labelexpert/(scene|device|mscene)|src/api/universal/(scene|mscene|mscene-item)|src/components/tree-view|src/types/vendor"
- cd woodii && npm run build:dev
- cd woodii && npm run build:stg
